principles: Keep Routeability as global current-22 membership and keep its frozen v0.2 weights plus v0.3 threshold unchanged unless a separately versioned future model is justified.
Do not use one global Router margin threshold to repair fallback because wrong known-route selections and non-route false activations overlap strongly in margin.
Do not allow pure Head fallback merely because Routeability says route_known.
Separate candidate-specific route identity admission from global Routeability.
Block explicit modern informational, procedural, fee, tax, policy or administration targets before support rescue and fallback admission.
Current-target semantics outrank historical/background direction signals in Compatibility.
Do not modify traditional LiuYao observation selection in the semantic layer.

evidence.responsibility: extract explicit informational/procedural unsupported targets using modern language only
mustNot: infer traditional 六亲 or 用神
treat every mention of fees/tax/rules as unsupported when the actual current target is a supported outcome

compatibility.responsibility: review candidate route against explicit semantic evidence
requiredChanges: current debt_collection target overrides historical funds_outward background
commercial_transaction topic evidence may confirm when no informational/contract-review unsupported target exists
income_bonus and income_salary topic evidence may confirm when no policy/administration unsupported target exists
generic informational/procedural unsupported target contradicts current-22 route activation

routeability.responsibility: global current-22 membership plus confirmed strong/support rescue after Compatibility v0.3

fallbackIdentityGate.appliesOnlyWhen: Arbitration is null and Routeability is route_known

model.type: 22 independent binary logistic heads over the frozen 512-dimensional encoder vector
model.output: one sigmoid probability per current route
model.purpose: candidate-specific route identity validation with reject-all capability

decisionContract: score only Router Top1 and Top2 candidates
admit a candidate only when its validator score meets the separately calibrated fallback-admission threshold
if exactly one of Top1/Top2 is admitted, select it
if neither is admitted, return route_unresolved
if both are admitted, return route_unresolved in v0.1 rather than force a low-confidence choice
forbidden: threshold selection from Candidate v0.2 independent data
training from any sealed blind or independent set
using traditional LiuYao fields as features

selection.strongSupportPolicy: preserve v0.3 strong/support behavior except Compatibility v0.3 outcomes
selection.pureHeadFallbackPolicy: must consume Fallback Identity Gate v0.1; raw Routeability acceptance is insufficient

fallbackIdentityTrainingMayUse: existing Semantic Router train splits only
fresh v0.3 fallback-identity training augmentation created after this design freeze
trainingPolicy.freshCalibrationObjective: maximize fallback known-route retention subject to accepted route accuracy >= 0.98, overall non-route false activation <= 0.05, and each non-route subtype false activation <= 0.05
calibrationMayChoose: one global fallback-admission threshold for the 22 sigmoid validators
calibrationMustNotChoose: route-specific thresholds in Fallback Identity v0.1
